summary:
bash: FILTER='[ .[] | select(.status == "active") | { user_id: .id, username: .username, email: .email, last_login: (.last_login | split("T")[0]), role_count: (.roles | length), primary_role: (if (.roles | length) > 0 then .roles[0] else null end) } ] | sort_by(.username)'

summary:
bash: FILTER='[ .[] | select(.status == "active") | { user_id: .id, username: .username, email: .email, last_login: (.last_login | split("T")[0]), role_count: (.roles | length), primary_role: (if (.roles | length) > 0 then .roles[0] else null end) } ] | sort_by(.username)'
printf 'jq --indent 2 %s /app/users.json > /app/active_users_report.json\n' "'$FILTER'" > /app/cmd.sh
cat > /app/jq_args.yaml <<'EOF'
filter: "[ .[] | select(.status == \"active\") | { user_id: .id, username: .username, email: .email, last_login: (.last_login | split(\"T\")[0]), role_count: (.roles | length), primary_role: (if (.roles | length) > 0 then .roles[0] else null end) } ] | sort_by(.username)"
args:
  - "--indent 2"
EOF
cat /app/cmd.sh; echo ---; cat /app/jq_args.yaml
